Ayesha Kapoor | ayesha.kapoor313@example.com | +91 9395612021
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Detail-oriented Java developer with experience building and deploying backend services and microservices-based applications. Proven track record delivering APIs, optimizing data persistence, and improving deployment automation in Agile teams.

Technical Skills
Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Docker, Hibernate, REST APIs, Git

Work Experience

Java Developer, Infosys (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Implemented and maintained REST APIs for an internal payments reconciliation service using Java and Spring Boot, improving end-to-end processing throughput by 28%; used Docker for consistent build and deployment.
- Designed microservice interfaces and collaborated on containerized deployments with Docker to reduce environment-related defects by 40%.
- Contributed to code reviews and Git-based CI workflows to accelerate release cycles and ensure API contract stability.

Backend Engineer, Capgemini (Mar 2024 - Nov 2025)
- Developed microservices that ingested high-throughput event streams from Apache Kafka and persisted transactional state in MySQL, enabling near real-time analytics with <200ms processing latency.
- Built and secured REST APIs for customer data services, integrating authentication and rate limiting; improved API response times by 18% through query and index optimizations.
- Deployed services to AWS infrastructure with automated provisioning and Git-driven pipelines, reducing manual release steps and improving rollback capability.
- Implemented Hibernate-based data models and optimized queries for large tables to cut report generation time by half.

Java Developer, Ledgerly (Jun 2023 - Feb 2024)
- Developed Spring Boot microservices for ledger management and transaction processing using Java and Hibernate; implemented REST APIs consumed by frontend and partner services.
- Implemented unit and integration tests, and used Git for source control; optimized service startup and database connection handling to improve reliability in production.
- Collaborated with product and QA to deliver iterative improvements and bug fixes, resulting in a more stable release cadence.

Education
BBA, Christ University
